Hartweik

Biography

Hartweik is the imperial officer who confronts Kir on Suslanger. He dismisses Kir’s papers, treats him as a slave and notices that his red skin resembles a description in a report about an attack on scholars. His interest in reporting Kir is openly tied to the prospect of a reward. [1]
